initial.name: run_code
initial.description: Execute a TypeScript program against the available tools. Takes two required arguments: `code`, the BODY of an async function (erasable syntax only; top-level `await` and `return` work), and `description`, a short UI label that is never a substitute for `code`. Call tools as `await tools.name(args)` per the declarations in the system prompt. Only what you print or return is program output — curate it. Image-bearing subtool results are attached after the run.

code.description: Required on every call, including retries. The non-empty program body: an async TypeScript function body with the actual `await tools.name(args)` logic. Omitting it fails validation.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this program does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). This is a label only — never a substitute for `code`. Examples: "Count TODO markers across packages"; "Read failing test and its fixture"; "Rename config key in every cordis.yml".
